assumptions: The 'typical' salary is best represented by the median rather than the mean due to the presence of extreme outliers
Monthly salary values are in SAR as stated in the notes from the requester
limitations: All departments have 32 or more employees (hr=50, it=54, ops=32, sales=64), so none are small samples (<30 rows)
